_comment: Job-search MCP servers as configured in ~/.claude.json (user scope) on the workstation. Secrets are placeholders.
Only servers the job-search workflow actually calls are listed. See mcp-notes.md for tool lists, auth model and gotchas.
Copy the 'mcpServers' block into ~/.claude.json, or add each with: claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url> --header "Authorization: <AUTH_HEADER_VALUE>"

_project_level._note: The career-ops repo has no job-search MCP of its own; only the code-review-graph dev helper is project-scoped (also mirrored in .cursor/mcp.json and .opencode.json).
